hebrewText: וַ/יְבִיאֵ֣/נִי בַ/מָּבוֹא֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל כֶּ֣תֶף הַ/שַּׁעַר֒ אֶל הַ/לִּשְׁכ֤וֹת הַ/קֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶל הַ/כֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים הַ/פֹּנ֖וֹת צָפ֑וֹנָ/ה וְ/הִנֵּה שָׁ֣ם מָק֔וֹם ב/ירכת/ם בַּ/יַּרְכָתַ֖יִם יָֽמָּ/ה

tokens.bdb: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
tokens.kjv: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.
tokens.explanation: bo — vir, ir, entrar, chegar, avançar em direção a algo

tokens.bdb: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west; also (adverb with preposition) towards
tokens.kjv: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, [phrase] westward. Compare H4126 (מוֹבָא).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.enLiteralWord: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.explanation: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards
tokens.explanationEn: an entrance ; specifically sunset or the west; also  towards

tokens.bdb: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, [idiom] alike, as (soon as), because, [idiom] every, for, [phrase] forasmuch, [phrase] from whence, [phrase] how(-soever), [idiom] if, (so) that ((thing) which, wherein), [idiom] though, [phrase] until, [phrase] whatsoever, when, where ([phrase] -as, -in, -of, -on, -soever, -with), which, whilst, [phrase] whither(-soever), who(-m, -soever, -se). As it is indeclinable, it is often accompanied by the personal pronoun expletively, used to show the connection.
tokens.explanation: asher — pronome relativo: que, quem, o qual, cujo

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the shoulder (proper, i.e. upper end of the arm; as being the spot where the garments hang); figuratively, side-piece or lateral projection of anything
an opening, i.e. door or gate
near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: a room in a building (whether for storage, eating, or lodging)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.enLiteralWord: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.explanation: a room in a building (whether for storage
tokens.explanationEn: a room in a building (whether for storage

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.bdb: to turn; by implication, to face, i.e. appear, look, etc.
tokens.kjv: appear, at (even-) tide, behold, cast out, come on, [idiom] corner, dawning, empty, go away, lie, look, mark, pass away, prepare, regard, (have) respect (to), (re-) turn (aside, away, back, face, self), [idiom] right (early).

tokens.bdb: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)

tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
tokens.kjv: in it, [phrase] thence, there (-in, [phrase] of, [phrase] out), [phrase] thither, [phrase] whither.

tokens.bdb: properly, a standing, i.e. a spot; but used widely of a locality (general or specific); also (figuratively) of a condition (of body or mind)
tokens.kjv: country, [idiom] home, [idiom] open, place, room, space, [idiom] whither(-soever).
tokens.explanation: maqom — lugar, localidade, espaço físico, santuário

tokens.bdb: properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess
properly, the flank; but used only figuratively, the rear or recess

a sea (as breaking in noisy surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article), the Mediterranean Sea; sometimes a large river, or an artifical basin; locally, the west, or (rarely) the south
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
tokens.explanation: yam — mar, lago, oceano, ocidente (o mar fica a oeste)
tokens.explanationEn: a sea  or large body of water; specifically
